name: M5Stack 4-Relay Switch
description: The `m5stack_4relay` component controls the four relays of the [M5Stack 4-Relay Unit](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/4relay) over [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). Each relay switches up to 250 V AC or 28 V DC at 10 A, and the unit's LEDs follow the relays.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the unit. Defaults to `0x26`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) bus to use. Required with more than one bus.
